capture.description: Naturehike Ultralight Camping Chair — 2.38 lbs of Portable Comfort for Every Adventure Whether you're backpacking through mountain trails, casting a line at your favorite fishing spot, or settling in at a weekend music festival, the Naturehike ultralight camping chair delivers all-day comfort without weighing you down. At just 2.38 lbs (1.08 kg), this portable folding camp chair is lighter than most water bottles — yet strong enough to support up to 265 lbs on any terrain. 15-Second Setup — No Tools, No Frustration The internal bungee-cord frame auto-tensions the moment you snap the 7075 aluminum poles together. Just clip the seat fabric and sit down. Setting up your portable outdoor chair has never been this fast — spend more time enjoying nature, less time wrestling with gear. Aircraft-Grade 7075 Aluminum — 67% Stronger Unlike standard folding camp chairs that use fragile steel or 6061 alloy, our backpacking chair features 7075 aircraft-grade aluminum — the same material used in aviation. The dual-pole reinforced frame delivers rock-solid stability on rocky ground, sandy beaches, and muddy campsites alike. Anti-Sink Feet — Stay Stable on Sand & Mud Tired of your lightweight camp chair sinking into soft ground? Our patented anti-sinking feet spread the load across a wider surface, keeping you level and comfortable on sand, mud, grass, and loose gravel. Detachable for hard-surface use. Breathable Comfort That Lasts All Day The 600D Oxford fabric seat features double-stitched seams and side mesh panels for maximum airflow. An anti-static coating repels dust and debris — so you stay clean and comfortable whether you're on a 3-day hiking trip or a sunny beach picnic. Packs Down to 14.6" × 3.6" — Fits Anywhere This compact travel chair stows into the included carry bag and slides right into your backpack, car trunk, RV storage, or truck bed. The carry bag also doubles as a frame-mounted storage pouch for your phone, keys, and sunglasses while you relax. Perfect For: Backpacking & hiking trips Beach vacations & fishing trips Camping & car camping Music festivals & outdoor concerts Picnics, BBQs & tailgating Balcony, patio & indoor use What's in the Box: 1 × Naturehike ultralight camping chair (2.38 lbs) 1 × Carry bag / storage pouch 4 × Detachable anti-sink feet 1 × Quick-start guide Naturehike — Trusted by over 1 million outdoor enthusiasts worldwide since 2005.
